m1-case1-red.title: Scratch topology helpers + case 1 RED proof
m1-case1-red.imperative: Create tests/test_code_map_precommit_e2e.py. Add shared-scratch-git helpers: ONE local bare clone of this actual repo's common .git per fixture (never git clone twice to fake worktree topology -- clone once, then git worktree add off that one shared .git for every worktree a case needs). Implement case 1: worktree add at the pinned SHA (confirm via git rev-parse HEAD), hand-edit a tracked .py file, commit normally with NO hook installed, run `python -m pytest tests/test_code_map.py::MapTreeFreshnessTests -q` against that scratch checkout's own copy and assert it FAILS. Attest any check:null precondition before start. Encode RED as manual attest (c1), not a command check (a command check would run pytest and the test's own point is that the underlying freshness test fails, which is fine to assert programmatically here -- so this gate's own postcondition IS a command check: the e2e test itself must PASS, proving it correctly observed the failure).

postconditions.statement: case-1 red-proof test passes: it observes MapTreeFreshnessTests failing pre-install against the pinned-SHA scratch checkout

constraints: never git clone to fake multi-worktree topology
never touch this actual repo's own git state

m2-case2-3-install-green.title: Case 2 (real CLI install) + case 3 (GREEN proof)
m2-case2-3-install-green.imperative: Extend the same scratch worktree from case 1 (or a chained continuation of it): install via `python <scratch>/scripts/install_constellation.py --agent claude --scope project --skills charter` run as a real subprocess with cwd=scratch worktree (no --dest/--project override, so is_self_install(args) is True and install_git_pre_commit_hook=True fires for real via the __main__ entry point -- confirm via the wiring grep that this is the real entry point, not a test-only path). Then repeat the hand-edit-and-commit; assert `git log -1 --stat` includes map/INDEX.md (and map/ids.jsonl if changed) in the same commit, and MapTreeFreshnessTests now passes with no manual rebuild.

postconditions.statement: case 2+3 tests pass: real CLI install fires the hook; post-install commit auto-fixes staleness and MapTreeFreshnessTests passes

check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_code_map_precommit_e2e.py -k "case1 or case2 or case3" -q

constraints: install must go through the real __main__ CLI entry point, never a test-only override of git_repo_root

payload.cmd: python -m pytest tests/test_code_map_precommit_e2e.py -k "case1 or case2 or case3" -q

m3-case4-5-6-partial-commits.title: Cases 4-6: partial-commit shapes + unrelated-dirty-file
m3-case4-5-6-partial-commits.imperative: Case 4: pathspec-restricted `git commit -- <path>` naming only one of two changed tracked files; assert map/ untouched and the unstaged sibling stays dirty. Case 5: hunk-restricted `printf 'y\nn\n' | git commit -p` on a file with two well-separated hunks; assert map/ untouched and the rejected hunk's effect never lands. Case 6: an unrelated dirty tracked file NOT staged remains dirty and outside the commit after a stale-map commit. Each case gets its own fresh worktree off a shared scratch .git (new clone per case is fine; reuse the m1 helper).

postconditions.statement: cases 4, 5, 6 pass as real subprocess git evidence

check.command: python -m pytest tests/test_code_map_precommit_e2e.py -k "case4 or case5 or case6" -q

payload.cmd: python -m pytest tests/test_code_map_precommit_e2e.py -k "case4 or case5 or case6" -q

m4-case7-second-worktree.imperative: Add a second `git worktree add` off the SAME shared scratch .git as a first worktree (not a second clone). Install once from the first worktree. Commit for real from the second worktree; assert the hook fires there too (shared-hooks-directory fact, honestly exercised) and touches only that worktree's own map/ tree.

postconditions.statement: case 7 passes: hook installed once fires from a second worktree sharing the same .git

constraints: never git clone to fake the second worktree -- must be git worktree add off the same shared .git

m5-case8-timing-full-file.title: Case 8: timing + whole new file green
m5-case8-timing-full-file.imperative: Time a fresh end-to-end invocation equivalent to case 3 (worktree materialization through commit) using time.monotonic(); report the number captured from a real run (print or record it) next to gate 1's 2.9s-build-only / 3.25-3.77s-full-mechanism figures -- do not presume it stays the same. postconditions.statement: case 8 (timing) passes and the full new e2e test file is green end to end

constraints: report the measured number, do not presume a prior figure

why_trail.why: case1 red-proof test verified: fresh shared bare clone + worktree at pinned SHA 9d5aac6d, hand-edit with no hook installed, real commit, real pytest subprocess run of MapTreeFreshnessTests fails as expected (FAILED observed in output). 1 passed in 7.37s.

Discovered gates 1-2's git-hook wiring code is uncommitted in this actual repo's working tree, so a pinned-SHA scratch worktree checked out via git worktree add does not carry it from history. Added _snapshot_gates_1_2_onto() to copy gates 1-2's current (uncommitted) scripts/code_map + scripts/hooks + scripts/install_constellation.py content onto each scratch worktree used for cases 2+ (never for case 1's red proof, which must run without it) and commit it as a baseline. Also fixed hook-path resolution: a linked worktree's .git is a file pointer, so hooks live at the shared bare clone's own hooks/ dir, not <worktree>/.git/hooks -- added _resolve_hooks_dir() mirroring installer's own resolve_git_hooks_dir(). Cases 1-3 now pass for real: 2 passed in 17.97s.

Cases 4-6 pass for real. Fixed an initial hunk-splitting bug in case 5's fixture (two end-of-file insertions merge into one contiguous diff hunk with no unchanged context between them; moved one insertion to right after EXCLUDED_PREFIXES with ~20 unchanged original lines before the EOF insertion, which correctly splits into two hunks). Also fixed an assertion bug: function names never survive the copy-back into root map/INDEX.md (only per-module entity counts do, per this repo's own MANAGED_PATHS constraint) -- added _module_entity_count() to read the per-module (N entities) figure instead of substring-matching a function name. 3 passed in 16.36s.

Case 7 passes: installed once from the first worktree, both worktrees resolve to the identical shared hooks dir, second worktree's commit fires the hook for real (map/INDEX.md in its own commit stat, MapTreeFreshnessTests green there), and the first worktree's own status stays clean throughout. 1 passed in 12.16s.

Case 8 measured 5.49s for a full fresh end-to-end invocation (bare clone + worktree add + real CLI install + hand-edit + commit), reported next to gate 1's build/commit-only figures with the extra scope named explicitly. Full new e2e file green: 7 passed in 52.61s (all 8 numbered cases covered across 7 test methods, cases 2+3 share one method since they are explicitly sequential per the handoff).
